articles.title: The Movement Club Expands Into Home Fitness Equipment with Launch of The Everything Band
articles.mainIdea: The Movement Club Expands Into Home Fitness Equipment with Launch of The Everything Band
articles.summary: PR Newswire: The Movement Club Expands Into Home Fitness Equipment with Launch of The Everything Band. Today, The Movement Club (TMC), an award-winning fitness platform founded by former Dancing with the Stars pro Lindsay Arnold, is officially expanding beyond digital with the launch of its first physical product, The Everything Band. The innovative resistance tool marks a significant brand milestone as TMC enters the home fitness equipment category with a product created to simplify and elevate at-home movement.
